Campus & infrastructure

A campus built around healthcare learning.

Teaching spaces, practical laboratories, library resources, computer facilities and academic gathering spaces support learning across the institution.

Explore facilitiesView gallery
OverviewLaboratoriesFacilitiesCampus filmGallery

Learning environment

Spaces for study, practice and professional preparation.

The campus brings classroom learning together with nursing laboratories, audio-visual teaching, computing and spaces for seminars and academic exchange.

Modern lecture theatres and subject-focused facilities support student-centred learning, independent study, critical thinking and practical preparation.

Practical education

Nursing laboratories designed for demonstration and practice.

Specialised learning environments connect healthcare theory with hands-on activities and guided instruction.

Campus facilities include the Advanced Nursing Practice Lab, Community Lab, Child Health Lab, Nutrition Lab, Gynaecology Lab and Pre Clinical Lab.

See all laboratory photographs →

Campus resources

Infrastructure supporting the academic day.

Purpose-built academic facilities create distinct environments for teaching, practice, study and professional exchange.

01

Lecture theatres & academic spaces

Modern lecture theatres supported by technology, together with an Audio Visual Aids Room for instructional presentations and demonstrations.

02

Library resources

Four libraries and one central library provide access to books, references, periodicals, magazines, and national and international journals.

03

Laboratories

Departmental laboratories support practical learning with instruments, machines, models and subject-specific teaching materials.

04

Computer facilities

Computer facilities include desktop workstations, current software and Wi-Fi-enabled computers for academic use.

05

Conference & seminar spaces

Conference rooms and seminar halls support conferences, seminars and lecture series on campus.

Digital facilities

Technology integrated into the learning environment.

Dedicated computer facilities support academic work through desktop systems, software and network access.
